name: Cleft Mitral Valve

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Echocardiographic Diagnostic Criteria for Cleft Mitral Valve

criteria.description: Visualization of a cleft or slit-like defect in the anterior leaflet of the mitral valve on echocardiography
Presence of mitral valve regurgitation demonstrated by Doppler echocardiography
Exclusion of other congenital mitral valve malformations or associated complex congenital heart defects

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Echocardiographic visualization of mitral valve cleft with associated mitral regurgitation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on transthoracic or transesophageal echocardiography; cardiac MRI may be adjunctive.

laboratory: Nonspecific; may show elevated BNP in heart failure
imaging: Echocardiographic identification of anterior mitral leaflet cleft
Cardiac MRI for detailed valve anatomy if echocardiography inconclusive
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be sporadic or associated with congenital syndromes
other: Electrocardiogram may show atrial enlargement or arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of cleft in anterior mitral leaflet

redFlags: Severe mitral regurgitation causing acute heart failure
Development of atrial fibrillation with hemodynamic compromise
Signs of infective endocarditis on mitral valve
